newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Minister denies in race for Dutch PTT job.
newsitem.headline: Minister denies in race for Dutch PTT job.

text.p: The Minister for Economic Affairs Hans Wijers denied on Tuesday a newspaper report he was a leading contender to head the telecoms unit of post and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN).
"The report is totally unfounded. There has been no contact between KPN and the minister about such a thing," Wijers' ministry said in a statement.
Dutch daily De Telegraaf reported that Wijers was expected to take up the post next year following Dutch PTT's decision last month to split into two separately listed units.
The current telecoms boss, Ben Verwaayen, has already announced his intention to leave KPN on September 1.
